question: In which year did scientists discover the virus that causes AIDS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1983**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• In **1983** the **HIV virus (virus for AIDS) was isolated and identified by researchers at the Pasteur Institute in France.**
